title: Binary width bound from a configuration code
statement: Let $x,y$ be finite bit strings, let $s$ be a natural number, and let $C$ be a configuration of a finite-tape Turing machine on input $x$. If the configuration word for $C$ with window parameter $s$ has length at most $|y|$, then the length of the binary expansion of $s$ is at most the length of the binary expansion of $|y|$.
hypotheses_covered: The configuration word has length at most $|y|$
